title: Uptrend: repeated breaks
description: Five bullish breaks of structure at level 1: 48,823, 50,213, 50,223, 50,785 and 51,592. Each swing is a high, a pullback and the close that breaks above the high. The swing from the 13 Feb 09:00 high survives a bearish market structure break at 13:00: price falls to 48,490, then closes above the high at 08:00 on 14 Feb.
